items.title: 「歐洲必須加入競賽！」黃仁勳預告20億美元AI投資
items.title_en: "Europe Must Join the Race!" Jensen Huang Announces $2 Billion AI Investment
paras: 輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳周二(13日)在巴黎表示，公司計劃未來一周宣布20億美元的歐洲投資案，延續過去一年已投入當地的80億美元布局。他也宣布對Doctolib、Genesis AI、Pigment及Entalpic等法國新創提供新資金，並喊話「歐洲必須加入競賽」。
据《彭博》報導，巴黎是黃仁勳此次歐洲行首站，後續還將前往倫敦與柏林。輝達已承諾在全球投入數千億美元，加速AI技術與旗下產品普及，但此次訪歐也碰上AI失控與資料中心耗能引發的反彈，歐洲及英國正尋求強化安全防護。
黃仁勳反對放慢AI發展，主張這項技術能促進經濟，也可安全推進。相較之下，在多起AI代理引發重大安全事件後，Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)與OpenAI執行長阿特曼(Sam Altman)等業界領袖，正思考如何掌握開發步調。
黃仁勳並將開源模型視為歐洲追趕美國AI發展的途徑，強調成本與客製化優勢，可依不同語言及自主掌控需求調整，也有助減少對少數大型公司的依賴。
輝達已投資法國開放權重模型業者Mistral AI，並為其資料中心供應加速器。Mistral最新模型使用4,000顆Grace Blackwell晶片訓練。
此次獲投資的Doctolib成立於2013年，提供醫療行政與預約服務。今年員工及早期投資人出售約3億歐元持股，交易估值約36億歐元，低於2022年募資時的58億歐元。
其餘三家則涵蓋不同AI應用：Pigment開發AI企業軟體，Entalpic投入化學與材料研究，Genesis AI專攻機器人。黃仁勳此前預期，以人形機器人為代表的實體AI，將成為輝達技術的下一個龐大市場。
paras_en: NVIDIA (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang said on Tuesday (the 13th) in Paris that the company plans to announce a $2 billion European investment within the next week, continuing the $8 billion it has already deployed in the region over the past year. He also announced fresh funding for French startups Doctolib, Genesis AI, Pigment and Entalpic, and urged that "Europe must join the race."

According to Bloomberg, Paris is the first stop of Huang's European tour, which will also include stops in London and Berlin. NVIDIA has pledged to spend hundreds of billions of dollars worldwide to accelerate AI technology and its products, but the European visit comes amid backlash over AI safety and data‑center energy consumption, with Europe and the UK seeking stronger safeguards.

Huang opposes slowing AI development, arguing the technology can boost the economy and can be advanced safely. By contrast, after several AI agents caused major safety incidents, industry leaders such as Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman are rethinking how to pace development.

Huang sees open‑source models as Europe’s path to catch up with U.S. AI progress, highlighting their cost and customization advantages, the ability to tailor them to different languages and control requirements, and the potential to reduce reliance on a handful of large firms.
NVIDIA has invested in French open‑weight model company Mistral AI and supplies accelerators for its data centers. Mistral’s latest model was trained on 4,000 Grace Blackwell chips.

The newly funded Doctolib, founded in 2013, provides medical administration and appointment services. This year its employees and early investors sold about €300 million of shares, valuing the company at roughly €3.6 billion, down from the €5.8 billion valuation at its 2022 fundraising round.

The other three firms cover different AI applications: Pigment develops AI enterprise software, Entalpic focuses on chemistry and materials research, and Genesis AI specializes in robotics. Huang previously predicted that embodied AI, exemplified by humanoid robots, will become the next huge market for NVIDIA’s technology.

items.title: AI支出何時降溫？高盛緊盯三大訊號、兩項已浮現
items.title_en: When Will AI Spending Cool? Goldman Sachs Watches Three Key Signals, Two Already Emerging
paras: AI投資熱潮背後的風險逐漸浮現。高盛資深宏觀交易員Bobby Molavi指出，判斷AI資本支出週期是否逼近轉折的三大訊號，已有兩項出現，包括股價與實際獲利背離，以及信貸市場重新評估AI融資風險，第三項資本支出增速放緩則尚待驗證。
Molavi估算，涵蓋大型科技公司、雲端服務商、AI實驗室、晶片與算力基礎設施的AI生態系，相關資產規模已達25兆至30兆美元，其價值高度仰賴持續擴張的基礎設施投資。
歷史經驗顯示，股價通常早於資本支出見頂，因此投資人須留意股價、獲利與融資條件的變化。
第一項訊號是股價與實際獲利背離。Molavi提醒，遠期本益比看似合理，仍須建立在企業獲利能夠兌現的基礎上。
報告指出，2000年3月，標普500遠期本益比為25.2倍，但以實際獲利計算達39.3倍；2007年遠期本益比僅15.1倍，以實際獲利計算卻達31.6倍，顯示預期獲利可能掩蓋估值風險。
第二項訊號是AI融資風險遭重新定價。今年已有超過5,000億美元債務發行用於支持AI基礎設施建設，多筆知名AI融資的發行殖利率持續攀升，投資級與非投資級債券信用利差也開始擴大，反映債權人正要求更高的風險補償。
第三項訊號則是資本支出增速實際放緩。高盛預測，超大規模雲端服務商資本支出年增率將於2026年第三季達到116%的高峰，隨後逐季回落，到2027年底降至20%出頭。
成長速度見頂不代表支出總額立即下降，但若市場先前已按投資持續加速的預期定價，增速放緩仍可能改變投資人對未來報酬的判斷。

融資降溫 投資報酬受檢驗

除了債務融資成本上升，股權籌資也明顯降溫。美國每月股權發行筆數從5月的65筆降至9月的24筆，季度發行總額則由第二季的2,520億美元降至第三季的930億美元，部分後續股權發行交易因表現疲弱而撤回。
儘管博通與SpaceX仍在籌備新一輪融資，高利率與投資報酬率的不確定性，已讓買方較上半年更加謹慎。市場對AI的關注，也正轉向巨額投資能否帶來相應回報。

指數創高 多數個股未受惠

Molavi將當前美股形容為「拼命奔跑卻原地踏步」。標普500持續創高，美國基本面多空策略的淨曝險卻降至約46%，接近2025年4月市場暴跌時的低位，反映專業投資人難以從這波漲勢中獲利。
美股集中度已超越2000年網路泡沫高峰。10檔核心AI相關股票占標普500總市值約40%，僅5檔股票的市值，就相當於另外434檔股票的總和。
今年表現最好的AI相關股票平均上漲58%，遠高於標普500的13%與那斯達克的22%，但標普500成分股報酬率中位數卻為負15%，凸顯指數上漲高度依賴少數大型企業。
個股與指數波動也出現明顯落差。個股3個月已實現波動率與指數的差距擴大至26至28個百分點，超過2009年約20個百分點的高點。個股漲跌相互抵銷，讓指數表面平穩，卻提高了實際交易難度。

成交量增加 市場承接力反降

市場流動性也在惡化。美股日均委託簿流動性自2023年以來下降21%，從約1,400萬美元降至1,100萬美元；每10億美元成交量對應的委託簿深度，則由2017年的16.2萬美元降至1.1萬美元，減幅約93%。
同期，日均成交量從約65億股增加至近190億股。交易更熱絡，委託簿深度卻縮減，意味市場承接大額交易的能力減弱，個股更容易因突發消息劇烈波動。

回購撐盤 仍難忽視外部壓力

股票回購仍為美股提供支撐。標普500成分股第二季回購規模年增20%，美國全年回購授權規模可望創新高，但能否抵銷市場對獲利與AI投資回報的疑慮，仍待觀察。
外部風險也持續累積。法國與德國10年期公債利差已觸及140個基點，創1990年以來最高，反映市場對法國財政與政治風險的擔憂。能源市場則受到地緣政治、航運與保險成本，以及煉油產能限制影響，緩衝空間逐漸縮小。
Molavi並未斷言AI投資已見頂，而是提醒市場正接近重新檢驗投資回報的關鍵階段。在股價與獲利背離、融資風險重新定價之際，若資本支出增速進一步放緩，高度集中的美股結構可能放大調整幅度。
paras_en: AI investment hype is revealing its risks. Goldman Sachs senior macro trader Bobby Molavi points to three signals that could indicate the AI capital‑spending cycle is nearing a turning point, two of which have already appeared: a divergence between stock prices and actual earnings, and the credit market re‑pricing AI financing risk. The third signal – a slowdown in capital‑expenditure growth – remains to be confirmed.

Molavi estimates that the AI ecosystem – encompassing large tech firms, cloud providers, AI labs, chips and compute infrastructure – now represents assets worth $25‑30 trillion, a value that depends heavily on continued infrastructure investment expansion.
Historical experience shows that stock prices usually peak before capital spending does, so investors need to watch changes in equity prices, earnings and financing conditions.

The first signal is a divergence between stock prices and actual earnings. Molavi warns that even if forward P/E ratios look reasonable, they must be backed by earnings that can actually be delivered.

The report notes that in March 2000 the S&P 500 forward P/E was 25.2×, but calculated on actual earnings it was 39.3×; in 2007 the forward P/E was only 15.1×, yet on actual earnings it was 31.6×, suggesting expected earnings may mask valuation risk.

The second signal is that AI financing risk is being re‑priced. Over $500 billion of debt has already been issued this year to fund AI infrastructure, and yields on several high‑profile AI issuances have kept climbing. Credit spreads on investment‑grade and high‑yield bonds have widened, reflecting creditors demanding higher risk compensation.

The third signal is an actual slowdown in capital‑expenditure growth. Goldman predicts that ultra‑large cloud providers’ cap‑ex annual growth will peak at 116 % in Q3 2026, then decline each quarter to just over 20 % by the end of 2027.

A peak in growth speed does not mean total spending will drop immediately, but if the market had priced in continuously accelerating investment, a slowdown could still alter investors’ expectations of future returns.

Financing is cooling and investment returns are under scrutiny. In addition to higher debt‑financing costs, equity fundraising has clearly cooled. U.S. monthly equity issuances fell from 65 in May to 24 in September, and quarterly proceeds dropped from $252 billion in Q2 to $93 billion in Q3, with some later equity deals withdrawn due to weak performance.

Although Broadcom and SpaceX are still preparing new financing rounds, high rates and uncertain returns have made buyers more cautious than in the first half of the year. Market attention on AI is shifting to whether massive investments can deliver commensurate returns.

Index highs not benefiting most stocks. Molavi describes the current U.S. equity market as “running hard but staying in place.” The S&P 500 keeps hitting new highs, yet net exposure to U.S. long‑short fundamentals strategies has fallen to about 46 %, near the low seen during the market crash of April 2025, indicating professional investors are struggling to profit from the rally.

U.S. equity concentration has now surpassed the peak of the 2000‑dot‑com bubble. Ten core AI‑related stocks account for roughly 40 % of the S&P 500’s total market cap, and the market cap of just five stocks equals that of the remaining 434 stocks combined.

This year’s best‑performing AI‑related stocks have risen an average of 58 %, far outpacing the S&P 500’s 13 % gain and the Nasdaq’s 22 % gain, yet the median return of S&P 500 constituents is –15 %, highlighting how the index’s rise is driven by a handful of large companies.

Individual stocks and the index have also diverged sharply in volatility. Over the past three months, the spread between individual‑stock volatility and index volatility has widened to 26‑28 percentage points, exceeding the roughly 20‑point high seen in 2009. Stock moves offset each other, making the index appear smooth while actual trading becomes harder.

Trading volume has risen while market‑absorption capacity has fallen. Daily average order‑book liquidity in U.S. equities has dropped 21 % since 2023, falling from about $14 million to $11 million; the depth of the order book per $10 billion of volume fell from $162,000 in 2017 to $11,000, a decline of about 93 %.

At the same time, daily trading volume has risen from roughly 6.5 billion shares to nearly 19 billion shares. Trading is more active, but the thinner order book means the market’s ability to absorb large trades is weakening, and individual stocks are more prone to sharp moves on news.

Share buybacks continue to support U.S. equities. S&P 500 component buybacks grew 20 % year‑over‑year in Q2, and U.S. buyback authorizations for the full year could hit a record high, though it remains to be seen whether they can offset concerns about earnings and AI‑investment returns.

External risks are also building. The spread between French and German 10‑year government bonds has reached 140 basis points, the widest since 1990, reflecting worries about France’s fiscal and political risks. Energy markets are being squeezed by geopolitics, shipping and insurance costs, and refining capacity constraints, shrinking the buffer available.

Molavi does not claim AI investment has peaked, but warns that the market is entering a critical phase of re‑examining investment returns. With stock‑price/earnings divergence and financing risk being re‑priced, a further slowdown in cap‑ex growth could amplify adjustments in a highly concentrated U.S. equity structure.

items.title: 華爾街大行財報亮點藏隱憂！股票交易撐場 成長動能能否延續？
items.title_en: Wall Street Big Banks' Earnings Highlight Hidden Risks! Can Stock Trading Drive Growth Sustainably?
paras: 華爾街大型銀行第三季業績呈現兩樣情。戰爭、通膨升溫與AI巨額投資疑慮攪動股債市場，一方面帶動投資人調整持股、推升股票交易收入，另一方面卻讓企業併購、上市與部分債券交易降溫。多家銀行高層指出，9月下旬業務放緩尤其明顯，市場關注這股壓力是否延續至第四季。
據《路透》報導，摩根大通(JPM-US)、富國銀行(WFC-US)與花旗(C-US)等銀行，在上半年強勁成長後，開始感受到全球債市持續下跌及股市震盪的影響。財報公布後，周二(13日)美股早盤銀行股漲跌不一，富國與花旗走低，摩根大通及高盛(GS-US)則上漲。

殖利率急升衝擊交易 企業募資與併購延後

富國銀行財務長Mike Santomassimo表示，9月最後幾周，客戶交易活動明顯放緩，美國10年期公債殖利率大幅攀升已對業務產生影響。摩根大通也指出，市場波動與經濟前景不明，抑制近月併購活動，並減少債市交易。
全球債市近期遭遇近年最猛烈的賣壓之一，多國公債殖利率升至本世紀初以來高點，加上股市波動，打亂企業交易安排。首次公開發行(IPO)市場近幾周也失去動能，讓原本有望表現亮眼的投行業務增添變數。
不過，分析師認為，IPO市場是變得更挑案子，並非完全關閉；若第四季市況穩定，延後的發行案仍可能重啟。
摩根大通財務長Jeremy Barnum表示，9月下半月投行活動確實放緩，但潛在交易案仍相當充足。他解釋，市場動盪時，買賣雙方價格認知的差距可能暫時擴大，直到找到新的平衡，因此他更傾向認為交易是延後，而非取消。
花旗財務長Gonzalo Luchetti也表示，繼上半年交易量創紀錄後，第三季投行活動轉弱。Zacks Investment Management首席市場策略師Brian Mulberry指出，高利率與聯準會(Fed)可能繼續升息的威脅，正對交易與投行業務造成明確負面影響。

股票交易撐住業績 成長能否持續成焦點

儘管部分業務降溫，市場震盪仍為股票交易帶來商機。摩根大通第三季市場業務收入年增15%，其中股票交易收入大增49%，主要受惠於投資人因應全球利率不確定性及能源價格上漲，重新調整投資組合。
高盛第三季獲利也優於預期，交易撮合業務維持穩定，中東衝突引發的市場波動則推升股票交易收入。不過，固定收益、外匯及大宗商品交易收入較去年同期減少1%，凸顯不同業務表現不一。
股票交易強勁雖為財報提供支撐，分析師仍關注其延續性。Oppenheimer分析師Chris Kotowski表示，對大型投行的主要疑慮，在於優於預期的表現似乎過度集中於股票交易，這股動能能維持多久，仍有待觀察。
paras_en: Wall Street's major banks posted mixed third‑quarter results. War, rising inflation and concerns over massive AI spending have stirred equity and bond markets, prompting investors to rebalance holdings and boosting stock‑trading revenue, while cooling corporate M&A, IPOs and some bond trading. Several senior bank officials noted that business slowed markedly in late September, and the market is watching whether this pressure will carry into Q4.

According to Reuters, after strong growth in the first half of the year, JPMorgan (JPM‑US), Wells Fargo (WFC‑US) and Citi (C‑US) began feeling the impact of a persistently falling global bond market and volatile equities. After earnings were released, U.S. bank stocks were mixed in early trade on Tuesday the 13th – Wells Fargo and Citi fell, while JPMorgan and Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) rose.

Yield spikes hit trading, delaying corporate financing and M&A. Wells Fargo CFO Mike Santomassimo said client trading activity noticeably slowed in the last weeks of September, and the sharp rise in the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield has already affected business. JPMorgan also warned that market volatility and an unclear economic outlook are dampening recent M&A activity and cutting back bond‑market trading.

The global bond market has recently endured one of the toughest sell‑offs in years, with sovereign yields climbing to their highest levels since the early 2000s. Combined with equity market swings, this has disrupted corporate transaction timing. The IPO market has also lost momentum in recent weeks, adding uncertainty to investment‑banking revenue that had been expected to shine.
Nevertheless, analysts say the IPO market is becoming more selective rather than shut down; if conditions stabilize in Q4, delayed offerings could be revived.

JPMorgan CFO Jeremy Barnum noted that investment‑banking activity did indeed slow in the second half of September, but the pipeline of potential deals remains robust. He explained that during market turbulence the price gap between buyers and sellers can temporarily widen until a new equilibrium is found, so he views the slowdown as a postponement rather than a cancellation of transactions.

Citi CFO Gonzalo Luchetti also said that after a record‑high first‑half trading volume, investment‑banking activity weakened in Q3. Zacks Investment Management chief market strategist Brian Mulberry pointed out that high rates and the prospect of further Fed hikes pose a clear negative impact on trading and investment‑banking business.

Stock trading bolstered earnings, making growth sustainability the focal point. Despite some business cooling, market volatility created opportunities for equity trading. JPMorgan’s Q3 market‑business revenue rose 15% year‑over‑year, with stock‑trading revenue jumping 49%, driven mainly by investors reshuffling portfolios amid global rate uncertainty and higher energy prices.

Goldman Sachs also beat profit expectations in Q3, with its brokerage‑matching business remaining steady and Middle‑East conflict‑driven market swings lifting equity‑trading revenue. However, fixed‑income, foreign‑exchange and commodities revenues fell 1% versus a year earlier, highlighting uneven performance across segments.

While strong equity trading underpinned the results, analysts remain focused on its durability. Oppenheimer analyst Chris Kotowski said the main concern for large banks is that the out‑performance appears overly reliant on stock trading, and it remains to be seen how long that momentum can be sustained.

items.title: 看好Google明年AI支出增75%！分析師點名博通、邁威爾與Arista為三大贏家
paras: Google Cloud正快速成長，投資人若想掌握人工智慧(AI)商機，除了Alphabet(GOOGL-US)本身，還可以留意為Google擴建資料中心基礎設施的晶片製造商與網路設備供應商，Melius Research分析師Ben Reitzes點名三檔受惠股：博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)、邁威爾科技(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)，以及網路設備供應商Arista Networks(ANET-US)。
Reitzes預期，Alphabet在10月底公布新一季財報時，Google Cloud將再度繳出強勁的成長表現，但真正的贏家將是為Google擴建資料中心基礎設施的半導體與網路設備供應商。
他周一(12日)維持對Alphabet股票的「中立」評級，但對博通、邁威爾及Arista提出明顯更為樂觀的展望。

Google明年AI基礎設施支出估增75%

Reitzes指出，Alphabet股價接下來到今年年底前可能因財報表現大幅優於預期而小幅上漲，但股價之所以未能跑贏市場，原因在於搜尋業務的長期成長率仍不明朗，而Gemini 4也尚未對Anthropic與OpenAI構成明顯威脅。
不過，Google Cloud若繳出強勁成績，可能促使Alphabet進一步提高基礎設施支出。Reitzes表示，為了持續推升業績，Google需要在模型開發上投入更多資金，並進一步擴大雲端運算容量。
Melius預估，Google 2027年將投入3520億美元推動AI基礎設施計畫，較2026年的預估支出增加75%。Alphabet周一收在每股352.72美元。

博通、邁威爾受惠客製化晶片需求

這項支出成長可能為博通帶來助益，該公司負責設計Google自研的張量處理器(TPU)晶片。博通周一收在每股354.73美元，而Reitzes給予博通610美元的目標價，意味著仍有逾70%的上漲空間。
博通股價已從今年稍早的高點下跌27%，原因是投資人擔心Google正把其他供應商納入TPU供應鏈。不過，Reitzes認為，博通目前的風險報酬已逐漸轉為有利，因為股價已反映引進其他供應商可能帶來的負面影響。
Melius團隊預估，儘管Google調整供應商組合，博通來自Google的客製化晶片營收仍將持續成長至2031年。此外，博通在本世紀後半也有機會把OpenAI與Anthropic也納入客戶群。
Anthropic目前是TPU的重要使用者。Reitzes表示，Anthropic未來可能與博通合作設計自有客製化晶片，以節省Google收取的加價成本。他說：「如果Anthropic推出新晶片，在利潤分配方面可能更有利可圖。」
邁威爾同樣可望因與Google日益深化的合作關係而受益。Reitzes表示，兩家公司已於8月建立合作夥伴關係，由邁威爾與Google共同設計客製化矽晶產品。
邁威爾也向Google授予認股權證，讓Google有權認購最高價值122億美元的股票。Reitzes給予邁威爾445美元的目標價，該股周一收在每股265.86美元。
摩根大通(JPMorgan)分析師Harlan Sur周一也把邁威爾與博通列為半導體產業中的首選標的。他評估後偏好具備AI業務曝險、供應受限下的成長動能、定價能力，或可受惠於景氣循環復甦擴大的公司，因為這些條件最有可能直接帶動財測上修。

Arista掌握高速網路設備商機

除了客製化晶片，Melius的Reitzes也看好網路設備領域的上漲空間。Arista提供高速網路交換器與相關軟體，負責連接不同晶片。該公司已成功爭取Google與Anthropic成為重要客戶。
Reitzes給予Arista 275美元的目標價，並指出，若Google的支出高於預期，Arista可能成為他所追蹤的公司中，受惠程度最大的標的。該公司股價周一收在每股210.88美元。

items.title: 稱AI投資人像「賭徒」！博通CEO：根本不知道自己在投資什麼、陳立武：記憶體或最先降溫
items.title_en: AI Investors Called 'Gamblers'! Broadcom CEO: They Have No Idea What They're Investing In, Lip-Bu Tan: Memory May Cool First
paras: 人工智慧（AI）熱潮吸引了不少投資人進場，但博通(AVGO-US) 執行長陳福陽（Hock Tan）表示，部分投資人的投資策略就像「賭徒」，並指出其中一些人對自己押注的對象可能缺乏充分了解。
根據《彭博》報導，陳福陽週一（12日）在新加坡出席活動時，對AI產業的發展提出坦率看法。博通為全球資料中心建置設計部分不可或缺的關鍵零組件。
陳福陽除了質疑企業是否將資金浪費在AI計畫上，也對持續虧損的AI實驗室能否在長期建立可行的經濟模式提出疑問。
不過，他特別將焦點放在市場爭相投資AI技術的現象，指出許多人其實並未正確理解這項技術，尤其是所謂技術尖端領域的大型語言模型（LLM）。
陳福陽表示：「很多投資人根本不知道自己在投資什麼。」他們「設定了極高的期望，最後卻發現，這幾乎就像是在賭場下注。」
包括ChatGPT開發商OpenAI在內的AI公司，已公布數十億美元的虧損。由於相關服務的開發與提供，需要投入巨額資金購買先進晶片、建置資料中心及開發模型，整個產業至今仍未找到可持續的商業模式。
陳福陽指出，OpenAI在9月達到年化營收500億美元，顯示尖端生成式AI模型確實具備龐大的營收成長潛力，但這項數字並不能保證公司未來能夠獲利。
陳福陽說：「目前它（OpenAI）仍然處於虧損狀態，因為他們在訓練模型上投入了大量資金。因此，坦白說，現階段這個數字並不能說明什麼，只能說明提供尖端生成式AI模型的服務具有龐大的潛在營收成長空間。」
陳福陽也警告，資金不足可能成為限制AI產業下一階段成長的瓶頸。獲輝達(NVDA-US) 支持的澳洲資料中心公司Firmus Grid Ltd.上週撤回原定規模55億美元的首次公開募股（IPO）計畫，顯示投資人對AI基礎設施公司的估值愈來愈抱持懷疑態度，尤其是那些高度仰賴未來營收預期支撐估值的企業。
在陳福陽發言前，星展銀行執行長陳淑珊也表示，在經歷大規模投資後，市場正重新評估AI融資的相關風險，並重新調整對這些風險的定價。
博通執行長陳福陽表示，AI模型開發商需要找到能夠透過導入這項技術創造投資回報的客戶，而不是依賴那些目前只是在試用AI、卻不斷「浪費錢」購買代幣（tokens）的使用者。
他以遊樂場的代幣作比喻指出，孩子拿到父母給的10美元代幣，可能短短10分鐘就花光，卻沒有真正學到什麼。他認為，部分企業目前使用AI的情況也類似。
這番言論反映出，隨著企業加速導入AI，市場關注焦點正逐漸從技術能力與使用量，轉向實際應用成效及投資報酬。
與博通CEO一同參加小組討論的英特爾(INTC-US) 執行長陳立武（Lip-Bu Tan）表示，AI基礎設施正快速擴建，意味著未來兩至三年硬體供應仍將持續短缺。
不過，他也指出，記憶體晶片市場可能是最早出現部分熱度降溫的領域之一。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: The AI hype has attracted many investors, but Broadcom (AVGO-US) CEO Hock Tan said some investors' strategies are like those of gamblers, noting that some lack a proper understanding of what they are betting on.
According to Bloomberg, Tan spoke candidly about AI industry development on Monday (the 12th) at an event in Singapore. Broadcom designs essential components for global data center construction.
Tan questioned whether companies are wasting money on AI projects and also doubted whether AI labs that continue to lose money can build a viable long‑term economic model.

However, he focused specifically on the frenzy of market participants pouring money into AI, pointing out that many do not truly understand the technology, especially large language models (LLMs) in the so‑called cutting‑edge field.
Tan said, “Many investors have no idea what they are investing in.” They “set extremely high expectations, only to find it’s almost like betting in a casino.”

AI firms, including ChatGPT developer OpenAI, have reported losses in the billions of dollars. Developing and delivering related services requires massive spending on advanced chips, data centers, and model development, and the industry has yet to find a sustainable business model.

Tan noted that OpenAI reached $50 billion in annualized revenue in September, showing that cutting‑edge generative AI models have huge revenue growth potential, but that figure does not guarantee future profitability.

Tan added, “OpenAI is still loss‑making because they pour huge capital into training models. Frankly, that number doesn’t tell us much right now; it only shows that providing cutting‑edge generative AI services has massive potential revenue growth.”

Tan also warned that a lack of funding could become a bottleneck for the next stage of AI industry growth. The Australian data‑center firm Firmus Grid Ltd., backed by Nvidia (NVDA‑US), withdrew its planned $5.5 billion IPO last week, indicating investors are increasingly skeptical of valuations for AI infrastructure companies, especially those relying heavily on future revenue expectations.
Before Tan’s remarks, DBS Bank CEO Piyush Gupta said that after massive investment, the market is re‑evaluating the risks of AI financing and readjusting risk pricing.

Tan said AI model developers need to find customers who can generate returns by adopting the technology, rather than relying on users who are merely trialing AI and continuously “wasting money” on buying tokens.
He used a playground token analogy: a child given $10 in tokens by parents might spend it all in ten minutes without learning anything. He believes some companies’ AI usage is similar.
These comments reflect that as firms accelerate AI adoption, market focus is shifting from technical capability and usage volume to actual application outcomes and investment returns.

Intel (INTC‑US) CEO Lip‑Bu Tan, who participated in the panel with Broadcom’s CEO, said AI infrastructure is expanding rapidly, meaning hardware supply will remain tight for the next two to three years.
However, he also noted that the memory chip market may be one of the first areas where some heat cools down.

items.title: 巴菲特警告成真？華爾街推5.5倍槓桿「對賭ETF」 押注標普500衝萬點
items.title_en: Did Buffett's Warning Come True? Wall Street Pushes 5.5‑Times Leveraged “Bet‑ETF” Betting on the S&P 500 Reaching 10,000 Points
paras: 華爾街金融商品愈來愈像賭博。美國ETF發行商Roundhill Investments近期推出一檔特殊基金，讓投資人押注標普500指數能否在2030年突破10,000點。
這項產品不僅具有約5.5倍的內嵌槓桿，更可能因指數未達目標而讓投資本金大幅虧損，再度引發市場對投資「賭場化」的質疑。
Roundhill Investments本月推出「Roundhill標普500目標10000點2030 ETF」，透過選擇權合約，讓投資人對標普500指數未來走勢進行長期槓桿押注。
與一般追蹤指數表現的ETF不同，這檔基金持有掛鉤標普500指數ETF的選擇權合約，其淨值主要取決於這些合約的市場價值。
當標普500指數逐步接近10,000點，選擇權價值通常會隨之提高，投資人獲利的可能性也會增加。然而，隨著合約到期日接近，選擇權也會面臨時間價值流失。
基金所持有的選擇權將於2030年1月10日到期。若屆時標普500指數高於10,000點，相關合約可望帶來可觀收益；反之，若指數未達目標，選擇權可能到期歸零。
因此，除了指數本身的漲跌，距離到期日的剩餘時間，以及市場波動率，都是影響這檔ETF價格的重要因素。
內嵌槓桿達5.5倍 漲跌幅遠超大盤
Roundhill投資長德魯佩蒂特（Drew Pettit）表示，目前基金持有的選擇權提供約5.5倍的內嵌槓桿，使其價格波動明顯高於標普500指數。
FactSet數據顯示，10月2日標普500指數上漲0.7%，這檔ETF卻大漲7.4%；10月8日標普500下跌0.5%，ETF則重挫4.9%。
週一(12日)易中，標普500指數僅小跌0.06%，該ETF則下跌0.26%，再次反映其波動幅度與大盤存在明顯差異。
近年來，利用選擇權等衍生性商品提供槓桿曝險的ETF大量增加，但多數產品主要針對短線交易者設計，採取每日重置槓桿的機制。
Roundhill這檔新產品則有所不同，並非著重每日漲跌，而是讓投資人針對標普500指數的長期走勢進行槓桿押注。
標普500每年只要漲8%就能達標
儘管10,000點看似遙遠，但在美股持續走高的背景下，這項目標並非完全不切實際。
標普500指數先前已連續三年繳出雙位數漲幅，並在本月初再創歷史新高。按照目前指數水準估算，若要在2030年達到10,000點，未來只需要維持約8%的年化複合成長率。
道瓊市場數據顯示，自1928年以來，標普500指數不含股息的長期價格年化複合報酬率約為6.4%。
換言之，8%的成長要求雖高於歷史平均，但差距並不算特別巨大，這也成為相關產品吸引投資人的重要因素。
不過，即使標普500指數持續上漲，也不代表這檔ETF一定能獲利。由於選擇權存在到期限制及時間價值損耗，投資人不僅必須看對方向，還得押對時間與漲幅。
專家批評投資遊戲化 本質近似賭博
ETF.com總裁兼研究總監納迪格（Dave Nadig）指出，這類產品實際上與預測市場相似，讓投資人針對特定結果進行「二元賭注」，投機性質相當明顯。
他認為，將長期槓桿押注包裝成ETF，可能使投資人低估其中的風險，因為產品外觀看似一般基金，實際運作卻與傳統長期投資存在重大差異。
納迪格形容，這是一種相當奇特的市場參與方式，反映金融市場日益明顯的投資遊戲化趨勢。
他進一步指出，過去一年ETF產業推出的許多新產品，都帶有高度投機色彩。從產品開發、產業文化到行銷方式，金融商品正愈來愈接近賭博。
納迪格直言，如今市場上有人試圖將賭博融入金融市場的各個角落，而他強烈反對這種趨勢。
巴菲特早已示警 股市正變成賭場
這股投機熱潮，也與「股神」巴菲特長期倡導的價值投資理念形成鮮明對比。
巴菲特今年多次批評美股市場愈來愈受到短線投機交易主導，而非建立在企業長期價值之上。
在今年5月的波克夏股東大會上，他甚至將股市形容為「一座附帶賭場的教堂」，凸顯市場投機行為日益盛行。
巴菲特向來主張一般投資人應採取低成本、長期持有的投資策略。早在2013年，他便建議妻子的資產受託人，將90%的資金投入標普500指數基金。
2017年，他再次強調，當大量資金交由收取高額費用的華爾街專業人士管理時，真正獲得巨額利潤的往往是經理人，而不是投資人，因此無論資金規模大小，都應堅持低成本指數基金策略。
巴菲特同時反對過度使用槓桿，認為為了追求額外財富而拿自身資產承擔重大風險，並不值得。
相較於華爾街如今推出的高槓桿對賭ETF，巴菲特長期堅持的投資原則，正好呈現兩種截然不同的市場思維。
上月，波克夏宣布巴菲特將卸任董事長，轉任榮譽董事長並繼續留在董事會。過去60年間，波克夏創造近20%的年化複合報酬率，同期標普500指數則約為10%，也讓巴菲特的長期價值投資理念成為市場經典。
paras_en: Wall Street financial products are becoming more like gambling. U.S. ETF issuer Roundhill Investments recently launched a special fund that lets investors bet on whether the S&P 500 index can break the 10,000‑point mark by 2030.

The product carries about 5.5 times embedded leverage and could cause investors’ principal to suffer large losses if the index fails to hit the target, reigniting concerns about the “gamification” of investing.

Roundhill Investments launched the “Roundhill S&P 500 Target 10,000 Points 2030 ETF” this month, using options contracts to let investors place long‑term leveraged bets on the future direction of the S&P 500.
Unlike typical index‑tracking ETFs, this fund holds options contracts linked to an S&P 500 ETF, and its net asset value is primarily driven by the market value of those contracts.

As the S&P 500 approaches 10,000 points, the value of the options usually rises, increasing the chance of profit for investors. However, as the contracts near expiration, the options also lose time value.

The fund’s options expire on January 10, 2030. If the S&P 500 is above 10,000 points at that time, the contracts could generate substantial gains; if the index falls short, the options may expire worthless.
Thus, besides the index’s movement, the remaining time to expiration and market volatility are key factors influencing the ETF’s price.
Embedded leverage of 5.5 times leads to swings far beyond the market
Roundhill’s chief investment officer Drew Pettit said the options the fund holds provide roughly 5.5 times embedded leverage, making its price volatility markedly higher than the S&P 500.
FactSet data show that on October 2 the S&P 500 rose 0.7 % while the ETF jumped 7.4 %; on October 8 the index fell 0.5 % and the ETF plunged 4.9 %.
On Monday (the 12th) the S&P 500 slipped just 0.06 % while the ETF fell 0.26 %, again highlighting the ETF’s larger swings compared with the broader market.
In recent years, ETFs that use derivatives such as options to provide leveraged exposure have proliferated, but most are designed for short‑term traders and reset leverage daily.
Roundhill’s new product is different; it does not focus on daily moves but lets investors make leveraged bets on the S&P 500’s long‑term trajectory.
The S&P 500 only needs an 8 % annual gain to hit the target
Although 10,000 points may seem distant, the goal is not entirely unrealistic given the continued rise of U.S. equities.

The S&P 500 has posted double‑digit gains for three consecutive years and set a fresh all‑time high earlier this month. Based on current levels, reaching 10,000 points by 2030 would require roughly an 8 % compounded annual growth rate.
Dow Jones market data show that since 1928 the S&P 500’s price return (excluding dividends) has averaged about 6.4 % per year.
In other words, an 8 % growth target is higher than the historical average but not dramatically so, which helps make the product attractive to investors.

However, even if the S&P 500 keeps climbing, the ETF is not guaranteed to profit. Because options have expiration limits and lose time value, investors must not only pick the right direction but also the right timing and magnitude of the move.
Experts criticize the gamification of investing, saying it is essentially gambling

Dave Nadig, president and head of research at ETF.com, said products like this are akin to market forecasts that let investors place “binary bets” on specific outcomes, making their speculative nature obvious.

He believes packaging long‑term leveraged bets as an ETF may cause investors to underestimate the risk, since the product looks like a regular fund but operates very differently from traditional long‑term investing.
Nadig described it as a peculiar way to participate in the market, reflecting the increasingly obvious trend of gamifying finance.

He added that many new ETF products launched over the past year carry a high degree of speculation. From product development and industry culture to marketing, financial products are becoming ever more like gambling.
Nadig bluntly stated that today’s market sees attempts to inject gambling into every corner of finance, and he strongly opposes this trend.
Buffett long warned that the stock market is turning into a casino
This speculative frenzy stands in stark contrast to the value‑investment principles long championed by “the Oracle of Omaha,” Warren Buffett.
Buffett has repeatedly criticized this year how U.S. equities are being dominated by short‑term speculative trading rather than being grounded in long‑term corporate value.
At the Berkshire Hathaway shareholder meeting in May, he even likened the stock market to “a church with a casino attached,” underscoring the growing prevalence of speculative behavior.

Buffett has always advocated that ordinary investors adopt low‑cost, long‑term holding strategies. As early as 2013 he advised the trustee of his wife’s assets to allocate 90 % of the money to an S&P 500 index fund.

In 2017 he reiterated that when large sums are handed to high‑fee Wall Street professionals, the huge profits usually go to the managers, not the investors, so regardless of portfolio size one should stick to low‑cost index funds.
Buffett also opposes excessive leverage, arguing that taking on significant risk with one’s own assets to chase extra wealth is not worthwhile.
Compared with today’s high‑leverage “bet‑ETFs” launched by Wall Street, Buffett’s long‑standing investment principles illustrate two fundamentally different market mindsets.

Last month Berkshire announced that Buffett will step down as chairman, become honorary chairman and remain on the board. Over the past 60 years Berkshire has generated nearly a 20 % annualized compound return, while the S&P 500 has returned about 10 % over the same period, cementing Buffett’s long‑term value‑investment philosophy as a market classic.

items.title: 股六債四配置沒過時？部分美債殖利率破5%讓投資人重新盤算
items.title_en: Is the 60/40 Allocation of Six Parts Stocks and Four Parts Bonds Still Relevant? Some U.S. Bond Yields Breaking 5% Prompt Investors to Re‑evaluate
paras: 美債殖利率攀升，讓「六成股票、四成債券」的傳統60/40投資組合重新受到關注。隨著部分天期美債殖利率突破5%，債券提供的利息收入更具吸引力，也有望緩衝價格進一步下跌的衝擊。不過，投資人並非全面買進債券，而是更加重視利率敏感度與收益來源，讓配置中的「四成」出現新面貌。
據《路透》報導，2008年金融危機後，超低殖利率使債券除了分散風險外，能提供的收益有限，促使投資人提高股票比重。近年股債價格又經常同向變動，削弱傳統配置的避險效果，但最新一波殖利率上升，正改變市場盤算。

殖利率升高增添吸引力 股債分散效果仍待考驗

油價上漲、通膨與政府債務疑慮，將美國、德國及日本公債殖利率推向數十年高點，但不少分析師認為已接近頂部。三井住友金融集團(SMFG-US)利率策略師Monty Gandhi表示，供給因素引發的通膨衝擊曾傷害60/40組合，但目前殖利率讓債券配置更具理由，持有期間可取得不錯的利息收益。
Three Pins Capital高階主管Rajat Kumar認為，美國10年期公債殖利率若逼近5.5%，可能明顯拖慢經濟，限制聯準會(Fed)進一步升息的空間，也提高鎖定當前收益的吸引力。不過，美國銀行(BAC-US)10月基金經理人調查顯示，殖利率可能須升至約5.9%，才足以帶動資金明顯由股票轉向債券。
Royal London Asset Management於8月至9月上旬因通膨疑慮降低債券比重，9月稍晚則開始回補。但股債分散風險的效果尚未恢復：《路透》計算，截至9月底，全球股票與公債的滾動36個月相關係數約0.59，高於2009至2021年平均的負0.24，代表兩者更傾向同向變動。

四成配置不只買公債 資金偏好低利率敏感度

LSEG Lipper資料顯示，9月短期美國公債基金吸金145億美元，貸款參與型基金流入49億美元；公司債與高收益債基金則分別流出49億及45億美元，反映投資人仍有選擇地配置。
高盛(GS-US)指出，債券基金在拋售期間已大幅降低存續期間，也就是利率敏感度，達到過去平均而言、其後一至兩季殖利率往往下滑的極端程度。
分析師表示，新版配置中的「四成」，已從公債與投資等級債延伸至證券化資產、市政債、特別股及浮動利率工具，包括槓桿貸款與AAA級擔保貸款憑證(CLO)，提供不同收益與信用曝險選擇。
富達分析師認為，槓桿貸款的浮動利率可提供收益，並降低利率敏感度，因此能納入更廣泛的四成配置。真正的問題不在60/40是否「已死」，而是它如何演變，從單純防禦配置，擴大為管理風險與尋找報酬的來源。
paras_en: U.S. bond yields are climbing, bringing the traditional 60/40 portfolio of sixty percent stocks and forty percent bonds back into focus. As some longer‑dated U.S. Treasury yields have breached the 5% mark, the interest income from bonds becomes more attractive and could help cushion the impact of further price declines. However, investors are not buying bonds across the board; they are paying closer attention to interest‑rate sensitivity and sources of return, giving the “forty‑percent” portion a new complexion.

According to Reuters, after the 2008 financial crisis ultra‑low yields made bonds useful mainly for risk diversification, offering limited return and prompting investors to increase stock weightings. In recent years, equities and bonds have often moved in the same direction, weakening the hedge benefit of the classic mix, but the latest wave of yield rises is shifting market calculations.

Higher yields add appeal while the diversification benefit of stocks and bonds remains to be tested. Rising oil prices, inflation and sovereign‑debt concerns have pushed U.S., German and Japanese government‑bond yields to multi‑decade highs, though many analysts think they are nearing a peak. Monty Gandhi, rate strategist at Sumitomo Mitsui Financial Group (SMFG‑US), says supply‑driven inflation shocks have previously hurt 60/40 portfolios, but current yields now give stronger justification for bond exposure and can generate decent interest earnings over the holding period.

Rajat Kumar, senior executive at Three Pins Capital, warns that if the U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield approaches 5.5% it could noticeably slow the economy, limit the Fed’s room for further hikes, and make locking in current yields more attractive. Yet a Bank of America (BAC‑US) October fund‑manager survey suggests yields may need to rise to about 5.9% before capital flows shift markedly from equities to bonds.

Royal London Asset Management trimmed its bond allocation in August‑early September over inflation worries and began rebuilding later in September. However, the stock‑bond diversification effect has not yet recovered: Reuters calculates that as of the end of September the rolling 36‑month correlation between global equities and sovereign bonds was about 0.59, up from the 2009‑2021 average of –0.24, indicating a stronger tendency for them to move together.

The forty‑percent allocation now includes more than just sovereign bonds, reflecting a preference for lower rate sensitivity. LSEG Lipper data show that in September short‑term U.S. Treasury funds attracted $14.5 billion of net inflows, loan‑participation funds drew $4.9 billion, while corporate and high‑yield bond funds saw net outflows of $4.9 billion and $4.5 billion respectively, highlighting investors’ selective positioning.

Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) notes that bond funds have dramatically shortened their duration during the sell‑off, reducing rate sensitivity to an extreme level that historically precedes a decline in yields over the following one to two quarters.

Analysts say the modern “forty‑percent” slice now extends beyond sovereign and investment‑grade bonds to include securitized assets, municipal bonds, preferred stocks and floating‑rate instruments such as leveraged loans and AAA‑rated collateralized loan obligations (CLOs), offering a range of return and credit‑risk options.

Fidelity analysts argue that the floating‑rate nature of leveraged loans can provide yield while lowering rate sensitivity, making them suitable for inclusion in a broader forty‑percent allocation. The real question is not whether the 60/40 mix is “dead,” but how it evolves—from a pure defensive stance to a framework for risk management and return generation.

items.title: 美股逼近新高、機構卻忙避險 科技股從買超王變賣超王
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Near New Highs, Yet Institutions Hedge; Tech Stocks Shift from Net Buyers to Net Sellers
paras: 美股接近歷史高點，機構資金卻加速轉向優質股，避險步調為疫情衝擊以來罕見。
高盛指出，旗下品質因子（Goldman Sachs Quality Factor）過去8週上漲逾16%，科技股則從淨買入榜首驟然轉為賣超最多的類股，顯示指數表面平靜之下，投資人風險偏好已明顯降溫。
根據高盛資金流向策略師 Lee Coppersmith 最新報告，標普500指數距歷史高點不到1%，但成分股自各自高點回落的幅度，中位數已達16%。
以高盛偏好的市場廣度指標衡量，市場表現分化已惡化至網路泡沫破裂以來最差水準。
資金追逐優質資產的動向尤其明顯。高盛品質因子過去8週累計上漲逾16%，如此幅度自2020年疫情衝擊以來未曾出現，通常發生於市場承受重大壓力之際，而非指數徘徊歷史高點時。
Coppersmith 指出，標普500指數表面之下，存在遠比指數表現所呈現的更多避險情緒。
科技股買盤急轉 工業股接棒
高盛主經紀商業務數據顯示，科技股在先前5週中有4週位居淨買入榜首，上週卻轉為淨賣出最多的類股，賣壓同時來自多頭平倉與新增空頭部位。
科技股多空比率降至1.8，落在過去5年的第17百分位，但總持倉規模仍處於第97百分位，顯示資金部位依然龐大，新增買盤的積極性卻已大幅減弱。
相較之下，工業股終結連續5週淨賣出，買入速度創今年1月以來最快，達正1.8個標準差，且幾乎全數來自新建多頭部位。金融股同樣吸引資金流入，軟體股也展現相對強勢。
高盛認為，這是資金開始尋找領漲類股以外機會的初步跡象，但能否形成持續趨勢，仍待觀察。民生消費股則在過去8週中有7週遭淨賣出，多空比率降至5年來第3百分位；生技股也出現逾5年來最大的8週累計總持倉縮減。
持股集中 未必阻礙續漲
儘管避險情緒升溫，高盛認為，機構偏低的淨曝險反而可能為後市提供上漲支撐。
高盛美國股票情緒指標目前為負1.3，落在歷史上後續報酬相對可觀的區間。全球基本面多空基金淨槓桿比率處於過去一年第6百分位，美國則僅為第2百分位；避險基金整體淨槓桿比率位於第10百分位。總持倉雖仍偏高，但對市場方向的信心已明顯不足。
市場漲勢集中於少數權值股，也未必代表指數即將下跌。彭博統計，自1995年以來，標普500前十大成分股表現領先等權重指數逾8%的情況共出現13次，其後6個月及12個月的指數報酬中位數分別為10.1%與19.6%，均高於歷史中位數的6.9%與15%。
目前上述表現差距為855個基點。Coppersmith 表示，歷史經驗顯示，市場領漲結構極度集中，仍可與指數持續上漲並存。高盛因此認為，標普500未來1至3個月仍有望走高。
油價與利率牽動後市
高盛指出，油價與利率仍是主要下檔風險，也是限制市場情緒修復的關鍵。
10年期美債殖利率突破5%後，高盛利率團隊認為，殖利率後續走勢較偏向下行，利率波動率也開始回落。美股不需要美債價格大幅反彈，只要利率保持穩定，就足以獲得支撐。
油價風險則更為突出。高盛預估，布蘭特原油價格將於12月回落至每桶90美元，2027年均價為80美元，但近期風險明顯偏向上漲。目前油價仍包含每桶逾20美元的風險溢價，供應中斷疑慮尚未消退。
此外，高盛注意到，輝達下檔隱含波動率已降至疫情前未曾出現的低點。對希望避險AI交易平倉或品質因子部位過度集中的投資人而言，這可能提供對沖機會。
paras_en: U.S. equities are approaching historic peaks, but institutional capital is rapidly shifting toward high‑quality stocks, with hedging activity at levels not seen since the pandemic shock.

Goldman Sachs notes that its Quality Factor has risen over 16% in the past eight weeks, while tech stocks have abruptly moved from the top of the net‑buy list to the most heavily sold sector, indicating a clear cooling of investor risk appetite beneath a superficially calm index.

According to Goldman’s flow strategist Lee Coppersmith, the S&P 500 is less than 1% away from its all‑time high, yet the median pull‑back of its constituents from their individual peaks is already 16%.
Measured by Goldman’s preferred market‑breadth gauge, the divergence in market performance has deteriorated to its worst level since the dot‑com bubble burst.

The tilt toward high‑quality assets is especially pronounced. The Quality Factor’s cumulative 16% gain over the past eight weeks is the strongest since the 2020 pandemic shock, typically occurring when markets endure severe stress rather than when an index hovers near record highs.
Coppersmith points out that beneath the S&P 500’s surface lies far more hedging sentiment than the index’s performance suggests.
Tech buying flips, industrials take the lead

Goldman’s primary broker data show that tech stocks topped the net‑buy list for four of the past five weeks, but last week they became the sector with the largest net sell‑off, driven by both long‑position unwinding and new short positions.

The tech long‑short ratio fell to 1.8, placing it at the 17th percentile of the past five years, while total position size remains at the 97th percentile, indicating that capital remains sizable but new buying enthusiasm has sharply waned.

By contrast, industrials ended a five‑week streak of net selling, buying at the fastest pace since January 2024—up 1.8 standard deviations—and almost entirely from new long positions. Financials also attracted inflows, and software stocks showed relative strength.

Goldman sees this as an early sign that capital is beginning to look beyond the leading‑gain stocks, though whether it will develop into a sustained trend remains to be seen. Consumer‑discretionary stocks were net‑sold in seven of the past eight weeks, with their long‑short ratio dropping to the third percentile of the past five years; biotech stocks also recorded the largest eight‑week cumulative position reduction in over five years.
Concentration of holdings does not necessarily impede further gains
Even as hedging sentiment rises, Goldman believes that the relatively low net exposure of institutions could actually support future upside.

Goldman’s U.S. equity sentiment indicator is currently at –1.3, a range historically associated with attractive subsequent returns. Global long‑short fund net leverage sits at the 6th percentile of the past year, with the U.S. at the 2nd percentile; overall hedge‑fund net leverage is at the 10th percentile. While total position size remains elevated, confidence in market direction is clearly lacking.

Market gains are concentrated in a handful of large‑cap stocks, but that does not necessarily signal an imminent index decline. Bloomberg data show that since 1995, the S&P 500’s ten biggest constituents have outperformed an equal‑weight index by more than 8% on 13 occasions; the median index return over the following six and twelve months was 10.1% and 19.6%, respectively, both above the historical medians of 6.9% and 15%.

The current performance gap amounts to 855 basis points. Coppersmith says historical experience shows that even when market leadership is extremely concentrated, it can coexist with continued index gains. Consequently, Goldman expects the S&P 500 to remain on an upward trajectory over the next one to three months.
Oil and rates drive the outlook
Goldman notes that oil prices and interest rates remain the primary downside risks and key constraints on market‑sentiment recovery.

After the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield broke above 5%, Goldman’s rates team expects the yield curve to trend lower and rate volatility to ease. U.S. equities do not need a sharp rebound in Treasury prices; a stable rate environment alone should provide support.

Oil‑price risk is even more pronounced. Goldman projects Brent crude will fall to $90 per barrel in December and average $80 in 2027, but short‑term risk is clearly biased higher. Currently oil still carries a risk premium of over $20 per barrel, and concerns about supply disruptions have not fully dissipated.

Additionally, Goldman observes that Nvidia’s downside implied volatility has fallen to a pre‑pandemic low never seen before. For investors seeking to hedge AI‑related trades or who are over‑concentrated in quality‑factor positions, this may present a hedging opportunity.
