items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯雙殺！熱錢流出重貶1.9角摜破32元 創近2個月新低
items.title_en: TWD Faces Double Whammy in Stocks and Forex! Hot Money Outflows Sharply Devalue by 1.9 Points, Breaking 32 and Hitting Near‑Two‑Month Low
paras: 台北股匯市今(13)日遭逢中東局勢升溫、聯準會放鷹及AI疑慮等利空夾擊，上演股匯雙殺戲碼。台股大跌960.65點收在48341.31點，外資狂砍台股1653.42億元創史上第三大單日賣超，熱錢大舉匯出；新台幣兌美元匯率盤中重貶逾3角並摜破32元大關，下探32.237元。央行尾盤雖強力調節，終場仍收在32.085元、重貶1.9角，創下近2個月新低，兩大外匯市場總成交金額更爆出54.33億美元的史上次高量。
在外部利空與內憂夾擊下，台股今天開低走低，盤中最多曾重挫超過1200點，回測48000點整數關卡，台積電遭遇沉重賣壓，終場台股下跌960.65點，收在48341.31點，三大法人合計賣超金額高達1984.46億元。
其中，外資單日瘋狂砍台股高達1653.42億元，創下外資史上單日賣超金額第三高紀錄，且外資已呈連續5個交易日賣超，累計提款金額一口氣突破3100億元大關。由於台股目前位處相對歷史高檔區間，加上國際金融市場不確定性大幅升高，外資今年以來逢高調節動作頻頻，資金流向成為牽動台股與新台幣走勢的核心要素。

新台幣兌美元今以31.97元開盤後，隨即向下摜破32元整數關卡，貶值超過1角；台股收盤後，外資匯出潮湧現，貶勢急速擴大，連破32.1元與32.2元兩道重要防線，盤中最低一度觸及32.237元，重貶達3.42角，盤中貶幅更擴大至1%以上，寫下2025年6月30日以來的低位。今年7月17日與6月24日，外資賣超台股分別高達1890.39億元與1774.19億元，居史上第一與第二大賣超紀錄，但當時新台幣盤中貶幅皆未達2角，顯示今日外資匯出意圖強烈，匯市拋壓沉重。
面對外資瘋狂撤退帶來的龐大貶值壓力，尾盤在央行強力調節下，收斂近半跌幅，終場收在32.085元，重貶1.9角，創下近兩個月以來的新低，已連續4個交易日收黑。
此外，台北與元太外匯今日總成交金額高達54.33億美元，創下歷史次高紀錄，僅次於2008年3月馬英九當選總統時創下的55.61億美元史上最大量。
paras_en: Taipei's stock and forex markets today (13th) were hit by a perfect storm of negative factors including heightened Middle East tensions, a hawkish Fed, and AI‑related concerns, resulting in a double whammy for stocks and currency. The Taiwan index plunged 960.65 points to close at 48,341.31, foreign investors dumped a record‑third‑largest single‑day net sell of NT$165.342 billion, and hot money rushed out; the New Taiwan dollar fell more than 0.30 against the US dollar, breaking the 32‑yuan barrier to as low as 32.237. Although the central bank intervened strongly at the close, the rate still ended at 32.085, a 1.9‑point depreciation and a near‑two‑month low, while total turnover in the two major FX markets surged to a historic‑second‑high of US$5.433 billion.

Amid external headwinds and internal concerns, Taiwan’s stock market opened lower and stayed down, at one point dropping more than 1,200 points and testing the round‑number support at 48,000. TSMC faced heavy selling pressure, and the index finished down 960.65 points at 48,341.31, with the three major institutional investors net selling a combined NT$198.446 billion.

Foreign investors alone sold a staggering NT$165.342 billion of Taiwanese stocks in a single day, the third‑largest net sell on record, and have been net sellers for five consecutive trading days, with cumulative withdrawals surpassing NT$310 billion. Because the Taiwan index is currently near historic highs and global financial market uncertainty has risen sharply, foreign investors have been frequently adjusting their positions upward this year, making capital flows the key driver of both the stock market and the New Taiwan dollar’s movements.

The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$31.97 per US$ and immediately slipped below the 32‑yuan round number, depreciating by more than 0.10. After the stock market close, foreign outflows accelerated, pushing the currency past the critical 32.1 and 32.2 levels, with an intraday low of NT$32.237—a 0.342‑point drop and a decline of over 1 % intraday, the lowest since June 30, 2025. On July 17 and June 24 this year, foreign investors sold NT$189.039 billion and NT$177.419 billion of Taiwanese stocks respectively, the two largest net‑sell records, but the TWD’s intraday depreciation then was under 0.20, highlighting today’s unusually strong outflow pressure and heavy selling in the FX market.

Facing the massive depreciation pressure from the foreign capital exodus, the central bank’s strong late‑session intervention trimmed nearly half of the loss, ending the day at NT$32.085, a 1.9‑point drop and a near‑two‑month low, marking the fourth consecutive trading day of closing lower.

In addition, the total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets reached US$5.433 billion today, the second‑largest volume on record, surpassed only by the US$5.561 billion volume recorded in March 2008 when Ma Ying‑jeou was elected president.

items.title: 日銀總裁：潛在通膨相當接近2%目標 密切關注公債市場
items.title_en: BOJ Governor: Underlying inflation is quite close to the 2% target, closely monitoring the government bond market
paras: 日本央行總裁植田和男周二(13日)在眾議院預算委員會答詢時重申，日本當前基調性物價上漲率已「相當接近2%」的物價穩定目標。
植田指出，隨著薪資與物價溫和上漲的機制逐漸確立，將物價穩定在2%左右水準，是日銀貨幣政策當前運作的關鍵。
植田發言期間，美元兌日元盤中下跌0.22%，報158.28。
日銀於9月將政策利率上調至1.25%，創下31年來新高。目前金融市場預期12月前追加升息的機率高達約87%，知情人士透露，日銀最快可能於29日的金融政策決定會議中，判定基調物價已達標。
針對長期利率波動，植田表示，長期利率基本上由市場供需決定。受中東局勢引發通膨壓力、人工智慧相關大型公司債發行、各國財政政策及美國良好經濟數據等影響，全球利率走高並波及日本。他強調，日銀將持續密切觀察公債市場動向。
paras_en: BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda reiterated on Tuesday (the 13th) during a hearing before the House of Representatives Budget Committee that Japan’s current underlying price growth rate is "quite close" to the 2% price‑stability goal.
Ueda noted that as the mechanisms for modest wage and price increases become established, keeping inflation around 2% is the key to the current operation of the BOJ’s monetary policy.
During Ueda’s remarks, the dollar fell 0.22% against the yen in intraday trading, quoting 158.28 yen.

The BOJ raised its policy rate to 1.25% in September, a 31‑year high. Financial markets now assign roughly an 87% probability of another rate hike before December, and insiders say the BOJ could decide as early as its policy meeting on the 29th that the underlying price level has met the target.

Regarding long‑term rate fluctuations, Ueda said long‑term rates are essentially determined by market supply and demand. He cited inflation pressures from the Middle‑East situation, large AI‑related corporate bond issuances, fiscal policies worldwide, and strong U.S. economic data as factors pushing global rates higher and affecting Japan, and stressed that the BOJ will continue to closely watch developments in the government‑bond market.

Ukrainian President Zelensky said he is waiting for the details, and Russia has not responded. The market expects Russia to increase supply, which pushed oil prices lower on Monday and dampened the dollar. South Korean military reports that North Korea launched several ballistic missiles into its eastern waters – the fourth such launch this month – adding geopolitical risk and prompting safe‑haven buying of the yen. CFTC data showed that for the week ending 6 Oct, net long positions on the yen rose 12%, reflecting concerns that Japan might intervene in the FX market, boosting the yen. With Japan on holiday and trading thin, the USD/JPY fell to a low of 158.06.

Iranian Foreign Ministry spokesperson Baghaei said Tehran is still assessing the United States’ response to the proposal to reopen the Hormuz Strait, and the two sides continue communicating through intermediaries. Markets remain cautious. CFTC weekly data for the week ending 7 Oct showed net long positions on the dollar rose to about $36 billion, roughly three times the level three weeks earlier. Cleveland Fed President Mester noted that inflation pressures are beginning to affect corporate pricing plans, and the Fed should pivot relatively quickly to a more restrictive monetary stance. This week brings key U.S. data – CPI, PPI and retail sales – and overall inflation is expected to rebound strongly, lifting the dollar to a high of 158.75 against the yen. The dollar/yen is projected to find support around 158.00‑158.20 and face resistance near 158.80‑159.00.
EUR/USD

Opinions are split on whether the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ) will raise rates again this month. The New Zealand dollar trade‑weighted index (TWI) has fallen to its lowest level since 2011, making it the worst performer among the G10 currencies. Yesterday, oil prices retreated, and the market is waiting for the Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) meeting minutes and employment data to gauge the rate outlook, providing modest support for the Australian dollar. EU foreign and security policy chief Borrell welcomed the Russia‑Ukraine energy‑facility cease‑fire, which lifted the euro to a high of 1.1217 against the dollar.

IMF Managing Director Georgieva said the Middle‑East war has triggered an energy shock and a surge in AI investment, keeping inflation resilient. The IMF urges members to act swiftly when inflation rises and to work on reducing large fiscal deficits. However, continued tension in the Gulf weakens risk appetite. CFTC data for the week ending 6 Oct showed net short positions on the euro jumped 55% to the highest level since August last year, pushing the euro down to a low of 1.1154 against the dollar. The euro/dollar is expected to face resistance around 1.1160‑1.1180 and support near 1.1080‑1.1100.
GBP/USD

The Institute for Fiscal Studies (IFS) said that UK Chancellor Hill’s first budget this month will need to raise taxes or cut welfare spending to raise £36 billion, offsetting inflation‑driven public‑service cost pressures and funding higher defence spending. The IFS warned that if the Treasury does not adjust the previous chancellor’s tax and spending plans, markets will question its credibility, causing the pound to fall from a high of 1.3261 against the dollar. CFTC data for the week ending 5 Oct showed net short positions on the pound rose to the largest size since June. Ongoing Middle‑East tensions and uncertainty over a Russia‑Ukraine energy cease‑fire have halted the oil‑price decline, pressuring the pound to a low of 1.3197. The pound/dollar is projected to meet resistance around 1.3210‑1.3230 and support near 1.3120‑1.3140.

items.title: 高盛喊人民幣遭嚴重低估 預測一年內升至6.4元
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Says the Renminbi Is Severely Undervalued, Forecasts It Will Rise to 6.4 per Dollar Within a Year
paras: 高盛集團(GS-US) 外匯、利率及新興市場策略研究全球主管 Kamakshya Trivedi 表示，在每日交易額高達9.5兆美元的全球外匯市場中，人民幣走升是目前市場上最被低估的情境之一。
高盛估計，人民幣目前遭低估約 20% 至 25%，Trivedi 認為，這項估計仍屬「保守」。他指出，中國持續擴大的貿易順差，進一步強化人民幣升值的理由。
Trivedi 上週接受訪問時表示，高盛預期，未來一年人民幣兌美元人民幣/美元(CNYUSD) 匯率將從目前約 6.69 元升至 6.40 元，而根據該行的公允價值衡量指標，未來人民幣甚至可能升至6元左右。
人民幣上一次接近兌美元 6 元水準，是在 2014 年初，當時中國正經歷大量熱錢快速流入。
Trivedi 表示：「人們低估了人民幣可能升值的幅度。每當我們上調人民幣匯率預測時，市場共識與遠期市場仍未跟上調整的程度，都讓我感到意外。」
他補充說：「我們的看法非常簡單，人民幣升值將是漸進的過程，但這個趨勢會持續下去。」
人民幣遭低估20%至25% 貿易順差強化升值理由
高盛提出上述觀點之際，中國正面臨歐洲國家等主要貿易夥伴日益強烈的批評，指控北京透過人為壓低人民幣匯率來刺激出口。
北京則否認相關指控，強調匯率調整無法解決全球經濟的結構性失衡問題，並指出中國出口競爭力的提升，來自工業競爭力持續增強。
儘管中國當局已允許人民幣兌多數主要貨幣升值，且在嚴格管理的匯率制度下，人民幣兌美元已升至四年高點，但國際社會要求人民幣進一步升值的壓力仍持續增加。
在地緣政治緊張局勢與通膨居高不下推動美元反彈之際，人民幣成為少數仍有望持續升值的貨幣之一。
Trivedi指出，若進一步考量中國經常帳及對外收支表現，人民幣遭低估的程度將顯得「大得多」。
中國官方數據顯示，今年前八個月，中國貿易順差達 8,055 億美元。Trivedi表示：「因此，在我看來，毫無疑問，人民幣匯率明顯遭到低估。」
中國對人民幣升值態度轉變 維持貿易穩定成關鍵
Trivedi 認為，中國決策官員可能正逐漸接受人民幣進一步升值，部分原因在於維持穩定貿易關係的重要性。
中國與歐盟經過談判後，同意限制油電混合車出口，避免雙方爆發更廣泛的貿易摩擦。相關談判已於上週五結束。今年以來，人民幣兌歐元已升值超過 8%。
北京對人民幣走強的接受度提高，也反映中國出口產業結構正在轉變，尖端科技與先進製造業逐漸成為出口成長的主要動力。
Trivedi 表示：「即使從中國自身的角度來看，我認為他們最重視的仍是貿易關係的穩定。」
他進一步指出：「貿易關係維持穩定的時間愈長，我認為中國就愈能認知到，人民幣適度升值符合其基本總體經濟情勢。」
彭博市場策略師 Andre de Silva 則指出，中國作為全球資金提供者的角色日益重要，標誌著人民幣國際化進入新階段。
人民幣的影響力正從貿易結算與支付，進一步擴展至全球借貸、投資及避險市場。
人民幣穩步升值 有助推動國際化
Trivedi 也認為，人民幣走強符合北京提升人民幣國際地位的目標。
中國國家主席習近平先前曾承諾，將人民幣打造為強勢貨幣，使其廣泛應用於國際貿易、投資及外匯市場，並取得全球儲備貨幣地位。
Trivedi 表示：「我認為，溫和、漸進但持續的升值，也有助於實現人民幣國際化的目標。」
他補充說，人民幣升值也將使中國資產的投資報酬前景更具吸引力。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs Group (GS-US) global head of foreign exchange, rates and emerging markets strategy research, Kamakshya Trivedi, said that in the worldwide FX market with a daily turnover of up to $9.5 trillion, the appreciation of the renminbi is one of the most undervalued scenarios currently.

Goldman estimates the renminbi is presently undervalued by about 20% to 25%, and Trivedi believes this estimate is still “conservative.” He points to China’s continuously expanding trade surplus as further strengthening the case for RMB appreciation.

Trivedi told reporters last week that Goldman expects the RMB/USD exchange rate to move from roughly 6.69 today to 6.40 within a year, and according to the bank’s fair‑value metric the renminbi could even reach around 6.00 in the future.
The last time the renminbi approached the 6‑to‑1 level against the dollar was in early 2014, when China was experiencing a massive influx of hot money.

Trivedi said: “People underestimate how much the renminbi could appreciate. Every time we raise our RMB forecast, the market consensus and forward market lag behind the adjustment, which surprises me.”
He added: “Our view is simple – RMB appreciation will be a gradual process, but the trend will continue.”
Renminbi undervalued 20%‑25% – trade surplus reinforces appreciation case
Goldman voiced these views as China faces increasingly strong criticism from major trading partners such as European countries, accusing Beijing of artificially depressing the RMB to boost exports.

Beijing denies the allegations, emphasizing that exchange‑rate adjustments cannot solve the structural imbalances in the global economy and noting that China’s export competitiveness stems from a continuously strengthening industrial base.

Although Chinese authorities have allowed the renminbi to appreciate against most major currencies and, under a tightly managed regime, the RMB‑USD rate has risen to a four‑year high, international pressure for further appreciation remains strong.
Amid geopolitical tensions and persistently high inflation driving a dollar rebound, the renminbi is one of the few currencies still expected to keep appreciating.
Trivedi noted that if China’s current‑account and external‑balance performance are taken into account, the degree of RMB undervaluation would appear “much larger.”

Official Chinese data show that in the first eight months of this year the trade surplus reached $805.5 billion. Trivedi said: “Therefore, in my view there is no doubt the RMB exchange rate is clearly undervalued.”
China’s stance on RMB appreciation shifts – maintaining trade stability remains key
Trivedi believes Chinese policymakers may be gradually accepting further RMB appreciation, partly because maintaining stable trade relations is crucial.

After negotiations with the EU, China agreed to limit exports of hybrid electric vehicles to avoid broader trade frictions. The talks concluded last Friday, and the renminbi has appreciated more than 8% against the euro so far this year.
Beijing’s greater acceptance of a stronger RMB also reflects a structural shift in China’s export industries, with high‑tech and advanced manufacturing becoming the main drivers of export growth.
Trivedi said: “Even from China’s own perspective, I think the thing they value most is the stability of trade relations.”
He further noted: “The longer trade relations remain stable, the more China will recognize that a modest RMB appreciation fits its overall macroeconomic conditions.”
Bloomberg market strategist Andre de Silva pointed out that China’s role as a global capital provider is becoming increasingly important, marking a new stage in RMB internationalisation.
The renminbi’s influence is expanding from trade settlement and payments to global borrowing, investment and hedging markets.
Steady RMB appreciation helps drive its internationalisation
Trivedi also believes a stronger renminbi aligns with Beijing’s goal of raising the currency’s international status.

Chinese President Xi Jinping has previously pledged to make the renminbi a strong currency widely used in international trade, investment and foreign‑exchange markets, and to achieve global reserve‑currency status.
Trivedi said: “I think a gentle, gradual yet sustained appreciation also helps achieve the goal of RMB internationalisation.”
He added that a stronger renminbi will make the investment return outlook for Chinese assets more attractive.

paras: 美元周一(12日)維持在18個月高點，受到避險需求支撐。隨著中東地區在週末的攻擊行動升級，投資人保持謹慎，並等待本週稍晚公布的美國重要通膨數據。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.37%，報102.58，為2025年4月以來最高。
由於受到伊朗支持的葉門「青年運動」(Houthis)加大對沙烏地阿拉伯的攻擊，加上週末有兩艘油輪遭到攻擊，油價走勢震盪。
布蘭特原油期貨上漲2.3%，報每桶107.17 美元，接近兩週高點。
這些攻擊事件蓋過了美國總統川普週日宣布的俄羅斯與烏克蘭能源停火協議。該協議從一開始似乎就面臨威脅，因基輔指控莫斯科在當晚違反協議。
布蘭特原油價格目前仍比美國與以色列對伊朗開戰前高出近45%。
另一方面，克里夫蘭聯準(Fed)銀行總裁哈瑪克(Beth Hammack)週一表示，聯準會應該「相對迅速地」轉向限制性貨幣政策，以控制她認為已經擴散至更廣泛領域的通膨。
投資人持續增加美元的看漲部位。截至10月7日當週，美元看漲部位約達360億美元，較三週前的84億美元大幅增加。
LMAX Group市場策略師Joel Kruger表示，「我們不確信，這波最新的避險情緒會轉化為持續性的美元走強。」他指出，經濟數據正在降溫、通膨壓力有所緩和，而且市場已經反映聯準會預期升息的大部分影響。「我們認為美元進一步上漲的空間有限。」
市場焦點轉向美國通膨數據
週三公布的美國消費者通膨報告，是聯準會本月政策會議前最後幾項重要經濟數據之一，可能成為決定美元短期走勢的關鍵。
10月初，美國消費者信心進一步惡化。由於中東衝突推高生活成本，家庭對經濟的看法更加悲觀。
聯準會上個月升息，是自2023年以來首次升息，目的是抑制通膨。
芝商所(CME)FedWatch工具顯示，交易員目前預估聯準會本月維持利率不變的機率為78%，高於一個月前的51%。
Bannockburn Global Forex首席市場策略師 Marc Chandler表示，「本週真正焦點是消費者物價指數(CPI)數據，而通膨數字很可能仍會偏高。」他補充，聯準會在選舉前升息的情況非常罕見，因此聯準會採取行動的門檻相當高。
投資人也越來越擔心債券市場的大幅拋售。這波賣壓已經推升全球各地的借貸成本，使其升至數十年來高點。
歐元兌美元下跌0.4%，至1.1156 美元，接近17個月低點。上週歐元已連續第五週下跌，主要原因是投資人擔憂法國的財政狀況，尤其是在2027年總統大選之前。
法國10年期公債殖利率與德國公債殖利率之間的利差為140個基點。上週該利差一度接近160個基點，創2012年以來最大。
花旗集團G10外匯策略主管Dan Tobon表示，「情況沒有改善，也沒有明確的指引告訴我們，短期內要如何才能讓局勢好轉。現在有什麼理由要買進歐洲債券、買進歐元？很難找到理由，因此我們只能看著它持續走弱。」

paras_en: The dollar remained at an 18‑month high on Monday (the 12th), supported by safe‑haven demand. As attacks in the Middle East escalated over the weekend, investors stayed cautious and awaited key US inflation data due later this week.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.37% to 102.58, the highest level since April 2025.
Attacks by the Iran‑backed Yemeni “Youth Movement” (Houthis) on Saudi Arabia intensified, and two oil tankers were hit over the weekend, sending oil prices into a swing.
Brent crude futures climbed 2.3% to $107.17 a barrel, near a two‑week high.

These attacks eclipsed President Trump’s Sunday announcement of a Russia‑Ukraine energy cease‑fire agreement, which seemed threatened from the start after Kyiv accused Moscow of violating the pact that evening.
Brent prices are still roughly 45% above levels seen before the United States and Israel went to war with Iran.

On Monday, Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack said the Federal Reserve should shift “relatively quickly” to a restrictive monetary stance to curb inflation that she believes has spread to a broader range of the economy.
Investors kept adding to bullish dollar positions. As of the week ending Oct. 7, long positions on the dollar totalled about $36 billion, up sharply from $8.4 billion three weeks earlier.

LMAX Group market strategist Joel Kruger said, “We are not convinced this latest wave of safe‑haven sentiment will translate into a sustained dollar rally.” He noted that economic data are cooling, inflation pressures are easing, and markets have already priced in most of the Fed’s expected rate‑hike impact. “We think there is limited upside for the dollar,” he added.
Market focus shifts to US inflation data
Wednesday’s US consumer inflation report is one of the last major data points before the Fed’s policy meeting this month and could be decisive for the dollar’s short‑term direction.
In early October, US consumer confidence deteriorated further. Higher living costs driven by the Middle East conflict have made households more pessimistic about the economy.
The Fed’s rate hike last month was its first since 2023, aimed at taming inflation.
CME’s FedWatch tool shows traders now assign a 78% probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged this month, up from 51% a month ago.

Marc Chandler, chief market strategist at Bannockburn Global Forex, said, “The real focus this week is the CPI data, and the inflation numbers are likely still on the high side.” He added that a pre‑election rate hike is very rare, so the Fed’s threshold for action is quite high.
Investors are also growing increasingly worried about a sharp sell‑off in the bond market. This selling pressure has pushed borrowing costs worldwide to their highest levels in decades.

The euro fell 0.4% against the dollar to $1.1156, near a 17‑month low. It has slipped for the fifth consecutive week, mainly because investors are nervous about France’s fiscal outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
The spread between French 10‑year bond yields and German Bund yields stood at 140 basis points, having briefly neared 160 basis points last week – the widest gap since 2012.

Dan Tobon, head of G10 FX strategy at Citigroup, said, “The situation has not improved and there is no clear guidance on how things can get better in the short term. What reason is there now to buy European bonds or the euro? It’s hard to find any, so we can only watch it keep weakening.”
The dollar rose 0.2% against the yen to 158.66 yen.
The pound slipped 0.2% to $1.3203.

items.title: 拚科技強國也堆出債務山！中國非金融部門負債突破GDP三倍
items.title_en: Pursuing Technological Superpower Yet Piling Up Debt! China's Non‑Financial Sector Debt Exceeds Three Times GDP
paras: 中國持續透過大規模投資推進科技與軍事強國目標，債務負擔卻同步攀升，不僅壓縮國內經濟活力，也透過過剩產能與出口擴張，加深與貿易夥伴的摩擦。經濟學家指出，中國短期內未必爆發金融危機，但若繼續依賴低成本信貸支撐投資與虧損企業，金融體系恐逐漸失去效率，付出更多債務卻換不到相應成長。
據《華爾街日報》(WSJ)周一(12日)報導，國際清算銀行(BIS)資料顯示，涵蓋企業、政府及家庭借款的中國非金融部門信用總額，去年已超過國內生產毛額(GDP)的300%，較2019年底增加60個百分點，占比也遠高於美國。自習近平2012年底掌權以來，這項信用總額已增加逾43兆美元。

債務推升過剩產能 壓力透過出口向海外擴散

報導指出，大量借款流向需求不足的工廠與住宅建設，造成資源浪費，並引發激烈價格戰，侵蝕企業獲利與員工薪資。背負龐大債務的企業為了償債，持續生產超出國內需求的汽車、太陽能板與電子產品，再將商品銷往海外，使中國對全球的年度貿易順差達到約1兆美元。
這也讓中國債務問題逐漸外溢。包括歐洲在內的貿易夥伴，對中國電動車及其他產品大量湧入日益不滿，但北京目前似乎無意根本改變政策方向。
許多經濟學家認為，中國尚未面臨迫在眉睫的金融危機，部分原因是債務主要仰賴國內儲蓄支應，而非可能迅速撤資的外國投資人。不過，隨著經濟成長動能停滯，虧損企業背負的大量債務愈來愈難償還；若停止向這些企業提供新貸款，又可能使國有銀行承受鉅額損失。
榮鼎集團副董事Camille Boullenois表示，改變現有體系意味必須接受大量損失，而中國政府似乎尚未做好準備。她認為，較可能出現的情境是問題緩慢惡化，金融體系逐步衰退，創造成長的效率愈來愈低。
延後處理債務，也讓習近平得以繼續將資源投入新科技、軍事及其他戰略優先項目。中國官員認為，目前是確立中國與美國並列大國地位的機會窗口，因此將AI、太空科技與能源等核心技術投資視為關鍵。

地方融資平台負擔沉重 低利貸款延續企業借款

中國政府強調債務風險可控，近年中央政府借款約占GDP的30%，相較美國聯邦政府債務水準仍低。然而，這項數字並未涵蓋中國債務問題的主要來源，也就是地方層級的負擔。
過去幾年，地方政府為達成經濟成長目標、維持就業，透過地方政府融資平台新增數兆美元負債。許多平台參與地方房地產開發，也因此受到多年房市低迷重創。
國際貨幣基金(IMF)估計，若將地方政府官方借款及融資平台債務一併納入，中國廣義政府債務去年已膨脹至GDP的127%，高於2020年的98%。
企業債務也在具備良好報酬前景的投資機會減少之際持續增加。麥肯錫資料顯示，中國去年企業債務占GDP比率，約為全球平均的兩倍。
低成本信貸是重要推手。榮鼎集團引述中國央行資料指出，截至去年底，超過半數新增企業貸款的利率，等於或低於銀行提供給最優質企業客戶的貸款基準利率，比重遠高於幾年前。中國上市製造業公司去年的借款利率中位數約為2.4%。

擴大消費有助打破循環 政策轉向面臨戰略取捨

要化解債務問題，中國可能必須根本調整成長策略，降低對工廠等固定資產投資及商品出口的依賴。許多經濟學家主張，政府應優先採取能鼓勵家庭增加支出的政策，避免債務持續累積。
世界銀行資料顯示，2024年中國家庭消費占GDP的40%，美國則接近70%，反映兩國經濟結構的明顯差異。
中國今年第二季GDP年增4.3%，為逾三年來最慢增速，其中相當部分成長來自出口，也凸顯國內需求不足的問題。
北京雖表示希望提高家庭消費，但這意味政府必須減少對經濟資源配置的部分控制，也可能使資金從習近平優先扶植、用以縮小對美科技差距的產業流出。
柏林智庫墨卡托中國研究中心經濟與產業研究主管Jacob Gunter表示，中國官員傾向延續現有路線，但體系已逐漸觸及自身極限。他指出，地方政府補貼虧損企業以維持其營運，然而企業持續虧損，也代表沒有利潤可供課稅，進一步削弱地方財政收入基礎。
paras_en: China continues to push its technology and military superpower goals through massive investment, but its debt burden is rising in tandem, squeezing domestic economic vitality and, via excess capacity and export expansion, deepening friction with trade partners. Economists note that a financial crisis may not erupt in the short term, but if China keeps relying on cheap credit to support investment and loss‑making firms, the financial system could gradually lose efficiency, paying more debt without corresponding growth.

According to a Wall Street Journal report on Monday (the 12th), data from the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) show that total credit for China’s non‑financial sector—including corporate, government and household borrowing—exceeded 300% of GDP last year, up 60 percentage points since the end of 2019 and far higher than the United States. Since Xi Jinping took power at the end of 2012, this total credit has grown by more than $43 trillion.

Debt‑driven excess capacity spreads pressure abroad through exports. The report says large volumes of borrowing have flowed into factories and housing projects that lack demand, wasting resources and sparking fierce price wars that erode corporate profits and workers’ wages. Heavily indebted firms, to service their debt, keep producing cars, solar panels and electronics beyond domestic demand and ship them overseas, helping China generate an annual global trade surplus of about $1 trillion.

This also causes China’s debt problem to spill over. Trade partners, including Europe, are increasingly dissatisfied with the flood of Chinese electric vehicles and other products, yet Beijing appears unwilling to fundamentally change policy direction.

Many economists believe China is not yet facing an imminent financial crisis, partly because its debt is mainly funded by domestic savings rather than foreign investors who could pull out quickly. However, as growth momentum stalls, the massive debt carried by loss‑making firms becomes ever harder to repay; cutting off new loans to these firms could force state‑owned banks to absorb huge losses.

Camille Boullenois, vice‑chair of Rongding Group, said that changing the current system would require accepting large losses, and the Chinese government does not seem ready. She thinks the more likely scenario is a slow worsening of problems, a gradual decline of the financial system and increasingly low efficiency in generating growth.

Delaying debt resolution also lets Xi Jinping keep pouring resources into new technologies, the military and other strategic priorities. Chinese officials see the current window as an opportunity to cement China’s status as a peer great power with the United States, so they treat investments in AI, space technology and energy as critical.

Local financing platforms carry heavy burdens, and low‑interest loans keep corporate borrowing alive. The Chinese government stresses that debt risks are controllable; central‑government borrowing has been about 30% of GDP in recent years, still lower than the United States’ federal debt level. However, this figure does not include the main source of China’s debt problem—the liabilities at the local level.

In recent years, local governments have added several trillion dollars of debt through local financing platforms to meet growth targets and preserve employment. Many of these platforms have been involved in local real‑estate development and have therefore been hit hard by years of a sluggish housing market.

The International Monetary Fund estimates that if official local‑government borrowing and financing‑platform debt are combined, China’s broad‑based government debt swelled to 127% of GDP last year, up from 98% in 2020.

Corporate debt is also rising even as investment opportunities with good returns are dwindling. McKinsey data show that China’s corporate‑debt‑to‑GDP ratio last year was about twice the global average.

Cheap credit is a key driver. Rongding Group cites People’s Bank of China data indicating that by the end of last year, more than half of new corporate loans were priced at or below the benchmark rate offered to the most creditworthy corporate clients, a share far higher than a few years ago. The median borrowing rate for listed Chinese manufacturers was about 2.4% last year.

Expanding consumption could help break the cycle, but policy shifts involve strategic trade‑offs. To resolve the debt issue, China may need to fundamentally adjust its growth strategy, reducing reliance on factory‑type fixed‑asset investment and export‑driven growth. Many economists argue the government should prioritize policies that encourage households to spend more, preventing further debt accumulation.

World Bank data show that in 2024 household consumption accounted for 40% of China’s GDP, compared with nearly 70% in the United States, highlighting a stark structural difference between the two economies.

China’s GDP grew 4.3% year‑on‑year in the second quarter of this year, the slowest pace in over three years, with a sizable share of that growth coming from exports, underscoring weak domestic demand.

Beijing says it wants to boost household consumption, but that would require the government to relinquish some control over economic resource allocation and could divert funds away from industries that Xi prioritizes to narrow the technology gap with the United States.

Jacob Gunter, head of economics and industry research at the Berlin‑based Mercator Institute for China Studies, said Chinese officials tend to stick to the current path, but the system is gradually hitting its own limits. He noted that local governments subsidize loss‑making firms to keep them operating, yet continued losses mean there is no profit to tax, further eroding the fiscal base of local governments.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯震盪一度重貶逾1角 貶幅收斂險守31.9元關卡
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar, Stocks and Forex Volatile, Briefly Dropped Over 0.1, Decline Narrowed, Barely Held the 31.9 Level
paras: 雙十連假過後，台北股匯今(12)日連袂走跌，受中東局勢緊張、國際油價漲勢再起影響，新台幣兌美元一度重挫逾 1 角，但在央行進場調節後，貶勢逐漸收斂，終場收在 31.895 元、小貶 2 分，驚險守住 31.9 元關卡，台北與元太外匯市場總成交值 27.17 億美元。
觀察主要貨幣今天對美元表現，根據央行統計，美元指數小跌 0.03%，韓元強勢升值 0.79%，新加坡幣與人民幣均升值 0.12%；日元則貶值 0.18%，新台幣貶值 0.06%，主要亞幣走勢不同調。
台股今日面臨電子權值壓盤，但台積電跌幅收斂，金融股、貨櫃海運三雄齊力拉抬，加權指數開低走高，留下逾 500 點下影線，49000 點失而復得，終場小跌 11.48 點，收49301.96點。外資今日賣超 521.98 億元。
儘管近期經濟數據顯示美國通膨壓力持續存在，但市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍相對有限。根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預估，聯準會本月升息至少1碼的機率為19.4%，不過，認為12月會議升息的機率高達85.8%。
paras_en: After the Double‑Ten holiday, Taipei’s stock and forex markets fell together on the 12th. Fueled by heightened Middle‑East tensions and a resurgence in global oil prices, the New Taiwan dollar slipped more than 0.1 against the US dollar. After the central bank stepped in to smooth the market, the depreciation eased and closed at 31.895 NT$, a modest 2‑cent loss, narrowly staying above the 31.9 threshold. The total turnover in Taipei and Yuan‑Tai foreign‑exchange markets amounted to US$2.717 billion.

Looking at major currencies against the dollar today, central‑bank data show the US Dollar Index fell 0.03%. The Korean won appreciated strongly by 0.79%, while the Singapore dollar and the Chinese yuan each rose 0.12%. The Japanese yen weakened 0.18% and the New Taiwan dollar fell 0.06%, indicating divergent moves among Asian currencies.

Taiwan’s equity market faced pressure from heavyweight electronics stocks, but TSMC’s losses narrowed. Financial stocks and the three major container‑shipping firms rallied, pushing the weighted index from an opening decline to a gain, leaving a lower shadow of over 500 points. The 49,000‑point level was briefly lost and then regained, ending down 11.48 points at 49,301.96. Foreign investors sold a net US$52.198 billion today.

Although recent economic data show that inflation pressure in the United States remains, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Federal Reserve meeting are still relatively modest. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability of at least a one‑basis‑point increase this month is 19.4%, while the chance of a hike at the December meeting is as high as 85.8%.

items.title: 油價回落與出口商拋售 韓元飆升至兩年新高
items.title_en: Oil price drop and exporters sell-off, Won soars to two-year high
paras: 韓元周一(12日)飆升至兩年來新高，主要受國際油價下跌和南韓國內企業大量拋售美元的支撐。
在結束為期3天的公眾假期後，南韓外匯市場周一恢復交易，韓元兌美元強勁升值。韓元匯率盤中一度下跌 0.8% 至1美元兌 1,333.30 韓元，刷新近兩年來最高，隨後漲幅收窄至約 0.5%。
市場分析師，本次韓元走強主要受雙重因素驅動。首先，國際原油價格下挫削弱了美元強勢，帶動歐元、英鎊與日元等主要貨幣全面回升。其次，南韓本土出口企業(特別是半導體巨頭)大量拋售美元，加上創紀錄的出口成長與經常帳順差擴大，大幅增加了外匯市場上的美元供給。
首爾友利銀行(Woori Bank)經濟學家 Min Gyeong-won 指出，出口商的結匯需求將持續為韓元提供支撐，不過當天因日本市場休市導致整體交易量較為清淡，進一步加劇了匯率波動。
今年以來，韓元兌美元已累計升值達 7.7%。憑藉強勁的出口表現與企業結匯潮，韓元已擺脫上半年作為亞洲表現最差貨幣之一的陰霾，逆轉成為下半年亞洲地區表現最強勁的貨幣之一。
paras_en: The Korean won surged to a two‑year high on Monday the 12th, driven mainly by falling international oil prices and a massive sell‑off of dollars by South Korean companies.

After a three‑day public holiday, South Korea’s foreign‑exchange market resumed trading on Monday and the won appreciated sharply against the dollar. The rate briefly fell 0.8% to 1,333.30 won per dollar, a near‑two‑year peak, before the gain narrowed to about 0.5%.

Market analysts say the won’s strength this time was driven by two factors. First, the drop in global crude oil prices weakened the dollar, prompting a broad rally in major currencies such as the euro, pound and yen. Second, domestic exporters – especially semiconductor giants – dumped large amounts of dollars, and record export growth together with an expanding current‑account surplus greatly increased the supply of dollars in the FX market.

Woori Bank economist Min Gyeong‑won noted that exporters’ demand for foreign‑exchange settlement will continue to support the won, but trading was relatively thin that day because the Japanese market was closed, which further amplified rate volatility.

Since the start of the year, the won has appreciated by 7.7% against the dollar. Backed by strong export performance and a wave of corporate settlement, the won has shed its reputation as one of Asia’s worst‑performing currencies in the first half and has turned into one of the strongest performers in the region for the second half.
